name: Ellen Guydir
source: Ellen is a hardworking witch from the magic land staying at the Yachikojima household. She was chosen as a student studying abroad in the human world owing to her effort. She is rather familiar with Japan (the human world), and speaks Japanese fluently. However, Ellen has a fear of heights and a complex about her tiny chest.
